# FINAL EXPERIMENT DESIGN (design-only; nothing executed; outcome UNKNOWN)
Full copy saved at /workspace/DESIGN.md. Researcher directives A1–A7 (§6) are recorded as stated design choices, not paper facts.

## 0. Hypothesis and estimand
H1: Under matched zero-shot conditions, FuseLLM-7B (linear weight fusion of Llama-2-7b-chat + Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 at α=0.5) achieves higher macro-average accuracy on the 8-task Llama-2-lineage commonsense (CS) suite than Llama-2-7b-chat.
Estimand: Δ = mean_t[Acc_t(FuseLLM) − Acc_t(Llama-2-7b-chat)], t over 8 primary tasks, primary per-task metric per §2.4, bf16, matched harness/prompts/splits.

## 1. Conditions and rationale
- C1 Llama-2-7b-chat — hypothesis target; all deltas defined against it.
- C2 FuseLLM-7B official checkpoint — primary test condition (the artifact in the question).
- C3 Local re-fusion θ_f = 0.5θ_Llama + 0.5θ_Mistral — reproducibility control (agreement gate, not headline).
- C4 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 — parent control; attributes Δ to fusion rather than a stronger parent; enables 'fusion > max(parents)' decomposition.
- C5 α-sweep {0.0,0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.0} — diagnostic/secondary; α=0/1 double as identity negative controls; peak-vs-monotone trend tests whether α=0.5 is meaningful.
- C6 CommonsenseQA (secondary task; C1/C2/C4 only) — covers the alternate reading of "CommenSense" without contaminating the primary average.

## 2. Protocol
2.1 Tasks (harness id, split, N): boolq(test,3270), piqa(val,1000), social_iqa(val,1000), hellaswag(val,10042), winogrande(val,1267), arc_easy(test,2376), arc_challenge(test,1172), openbookqa(test,500); secondary commonsense_qa(val,1221). Splits chosen because public test labels are unavailable for PIQA/SIQA/WinoGrande/CSQA (harness defaults). Dataset revisions pinned by commit; identical for all conditions.
2.2 Harness: EleutherAI lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.x (commit pinned in run manifest); num_fewshot=0 everywhere; no task-specific prompt engineering.
2.3 Prompting: each condition uses its native chat template (Llama template for C1/C3/C5; Mistral template for C4; template shipped with official FuseLLM config for C2); harness-default zero-shot task framing, identical across conditions. Secondary template ablation (plain text, C1/C2, fixed subsample).
2.4 Scoring: padded log-likelihood over answer continuations (no generation in the primary protocol); record both acc and acc_norm for every task. Pre-registered primary metric: acc_norm for length-heterogeneous continuation tasks (HellaSwag, PIQA, SIQA, WinoGrande, ARC-e, ARC-c, OBQA); acc for BoolQ (two equal-length fixed options). Justification from dataset continuation-length statistics (model-free computation), not leaderboard inheritance. Sensitivity annex reruns everything all-acc and all-acc_norm; if the verdict flips it must be reported. CommonsenseQA: likelihood over options + greedy (temp 0) exact match, descriptive only. No sampling anywhere → no seed-driven variance in the primary endpoint.
2.5 Fusion: elementwise interpolation of correspondingly NAMED weight tensors; no retraining/scale-matching; requires §3.4 pre-check; α=0.5 primary; official C2 never assumed equal to local fusion (C3 measures the gap).
2.6 Inference: bf16; padding_side='left'; flash-attention off for determinism; reproducibility check = C2 on ARC-c × 3 batch sizes, per-item logprob agreement ≤1e-3, spread folded into the C3 gate.
2.7 Compute budget (estimate, not measurement): ~20,627 items × ~2–4 candidate scorings ≈ 55k short forward passes; ≈4–10 GPU-h per 7B full 8-task zero-shot eval on 1×A100-80GB; full grid + sweep + controls ≈ 2–4 GPU-days on 1×A100-80GB, <1 day on 4×.

## 3. Controls (pre-registered)
3.1 Parent control (C4): report Δ(F−L), Δ(M−L), and fusion-vs-max(parents).
3.2 Re-fusion control (C3 vs C2): gate = mean per-task |diff| ≤ 0.5 pp and same decision direction; failure reported as checkpoint/recipe ambiguity; headline stays on official C2.
3.3 Precision/quantization control: ARC-c + WinoGrande for C1/C2 at bf16 vs fp32 (plus one int8/GGUF pass feeding the CPU smoke path); any claimed Δ smaller than observed bf16–fp32 drift is declared precision-confounded; quantized numbers excluded from headline.
3.4 Tokenizer/architecture compatibility pre-check (model-free): identical tokenizer (Llama sentencepiece/vocab) and identical tensor names/shapes before interpolation; load by names, never positional indices; mismatch aborts C3/C5.
3.5 Identity negative controls: α=1.0 must reproduce C1 within §2.6 spread; α=0.0 must reproduce C4; failure invalidates the fusion pipeline. Above-chance sanity checks per task/model (PIQA≥50%, ARC≥25%, BoolQ vs majority class) catch broken scoring plumbing.
3.6 Template ablation; 3.7 acc/acc_norm metric-family sensitivity.

## 4. Analysis plan (pre-registered)
Primary endpoint Δ(§0). Inference: item-level paired bootstrap, B=10,000 — resample items with replacement within each task, SAME indices reused across conditions (paired), tasks fixed at weight 1/8; percentile 95% CI on Δ. Consistency: per-task win count X/8 with descriptive binomial sign test. Per-task table: Holm–Bonferroni adjusted per-task bootstrap p-values only if per-task claims are made; otherwise descriptive (per-task wins are a descriptor, not a gate, per directive A2). CommonsenseQA outside primary multiplicity handling.
Decision rule (fixed in advance): (a) "FuseLLM outperforms Llama-2 on CS (zero-shot)" iff 95% CI lower bound for Δ > 0 AND all gates (3.2, 3.4, 3.5, precision drift) pass; (b) "no detectable difference" if CI covers 0; (c) "verdict withheld / implementation ambiguity" if any gate fails; negative direction = outperformance failure. All states legitimate; no expected direction asserted.
Secondary: α-sweep curve with per-point CIs and peak-vs-monotone check; parent attribution; CommonsenseQA table; template and metric-family annexes. Approximate sensitivity (design-time, not a power study): ~20.6k paired items → macro-avg bootstrap SE ~0.3–0.8 pp, minimum resolvable Δ ≈ 1 pp; smaller true deltas map to (b) by design.

## 5. Feasibility
Verified sandbox state (inspection only): /workspace = task.json only; no FuseLLM/Llama code, weights, or eval harness anywhere on disk; no torch/transformers/lm-eval/numpy; network disabled (DNS failure confirmed); no GPU; 224 CPU cores / ~2 TB RAM. The experiment CANNOT run here — design-only per the task note. External requirement: 1×80 GB GPU (A100/H100) or 2×≥48 GB; pinned harness commit + dataset revisions; gated HF access to Llama-2-7b-chat-hf, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, FuseLLM-7B; ~50 GB disk; ~2–4 GPU-days. CPU-only smoke test (never headline): GGUF or device_map=cpu, fixed 200 items/task, pipeline debugging only; declared confounds: quantization drift (bounded only by 3.3), ±4–8 pp per-task CI at n=200, weeks for full-suite CPU bf16.

## 6. Assumptions (= researcher directives A1–A7, stated choices, not verified paper facts)
A1 8-task Llama-2 CS suite primary; CommonsenseQA secondary/separate. A2 'Outperform' = macro-avg accuracy Δ (FuseLLM α=0.5 − Llama-2-7b-chat), paired-bootstrap 95% CI gate, per-task = descriptor. A3 Official FuseLLM-7B primary; local re-fusion = reproducibility control; α-sweep diagnostic. A4 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 under identical protocol as parent control. A5 Native chat templates + harness-default zero-shot prompts; acc and acc_norm recorded; acc_norm primary for length-biased tasks with dataset-statistics justification. A6 bf16 primary + explicit quantization control; no quantized headline numbers. A7 Published paper numbers are reference context only (paper leaderboard-style settings may not be zero-shot; absolute values expected to differ); decision rule is internal/matched.

## 7. Uncertainties
U1 Paper setup sections (iclr2024/18013/1:setup_2, setup_9) unreadable offline — design follows A1–A7, not verified paper text. U2 Chat-template effects on absolute scores (mitigated, not eliminated, by template ablation). U3 acc-vs-acc_norm per-task choice is a judgment bounded by sensitivity annex. U4 Official checkpoint provenance unverified (3.2 catches gross mismatch only). U5 Gated-asset access / harness revision logistics. U6 ~1 pp MDE: small true deltas resolve to "no detectable difference" by design, not equivalence evidence.

## 8. Outcome statement
No experiment was run; no result is claimed or implied. Whether H1 holds is UNKNOWN; the pre-registered decision rule fixes how each possible outcome will be labeled.
